result_text:
The average order value change in the year-over-year comparison is now empty when the current month has no orders, instead of showing -100%.

I added a check in `averageOrderValueChangePercent()` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/model/YearOverYearSales.java`: if `orderCount == 0`, it returns null. I also updated its Javadoc to match.

The revenue change is untouched, so it still shows -100% in that case. Regions with orders in both years are unchanged, so 20.00 to 40.00 still gives +100%. The case where last year had no orders still returns null as before.

I ran the full suite with `mvn -q -o test` and it passed. I didn't add a test for the no-orders case.
